mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS < 4% (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the tightening labor market drives wage inflation, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window despite the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of non-recessionary instances when INDPRO growth > 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding $700 billion indicates strong consumer demand, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 25bps increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) within a month, signaling monetary tightening, negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower after a 25bps FEDFUNDS hike (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in two months, signaling labor market weakness, S&P 500 forward returns are negatively impacted over the next 60 trading days, but only during economic downturns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 30% of downturn instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, combined with housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicates robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window despite the trigger conditions.
